batches.title: Batch 1: counters, economy, agendas and turn structure

cards.title: Ryō “Phoenix” Ōno: Out of the Ashes
cards.observation: Successful-run trigger gated on a per-run fact that a subroutine resolved; once per turn.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The Corp chooses the HQ card to trash; only the trashed card is revealed by moving to Archives faceup.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the subroutine-resolved run fact and the first-time-each-turn fact.

cards.title: Topan: Ormas Leader
cards.observation: Once-per-turn click ability installs from the grip at a 2-credit discount, with a delayed meat-damage trigger on that card's install.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The installed card becomes public on install; the grip stays private.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the bound installed card for the delayed trigger until its install completes.

cards.title: Charm Offensive
cards.observation: Run event on Archives; at run end the Runner may trash one rezzed installed copy of a card accessed in Archives during the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Archives accesses are public; the copy filter reads only cards the Runner accessed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the set of accessed definition IDs in the run's persistent context.

cards.title: Scrounge
cards.observation: Double event: install one program from the heap, then optionally move one heap program to the bottom of the stack.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The heap is public; the stack bottom placement hides no new information.
cards.serializationImpact: Install-source zone (heap) is part of the install frame.

cards.title: Shred
cards.observation: Run event; the first Corp end-run is prevented unless the Corp reveals and trashes X random HQ cards, X = cards in the attacked root.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Random HQ cards are revealed to both players as they are trashed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the one-shot prevention in the run state; the random draw uses DeterministicRandom.

cards.title: Bling
cards.observation: Console: after a credit-free install, may host the stack's top card faceup; hosted cards are playable or installable as from the grip; trashed at discard-phase end.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The hosted card becomes public when hosted faceup; the stack stays private.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted faceup non-installed cards live in a hosted zone on the console.

cards.title: Gourmand
cards.observation: Access ability: trash this program to trash the accessed non-agenda card and draw.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The accessed card is already visible to the Runner; trashing reveals it in Archives.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Hantu
cards.observation: Killer with two virus counters on install; spending a hosted virus counter gives +2 strength for the encounter.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Rising Tide
cards.observation: Fracter whose strength rises with fracters in the heap; the heap count is a dynamic static value.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Strength is derived from the public heap; nothing new is stored.

cards.title: Cacophony
cards.observation: First steal-or-trash of a Corp card each turn adds a power counter; at action-phase end may spend two to sabotage 3.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The Corp's HQ choice is private until trashed; trashed cards are revealed in Archives.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the shared first-steal-or-trash turn fact and the sabotage choice frame.

cards.title: Rent Rioters
cards.observation: Three clicks and trash: gain 9.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Barry “Baz” Wong: Tri-Maf Veteran
cards.observation: Whenever the Corp rezzes ice, the Runner may install a resource or hardware from the grip, paying costs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The installed card becomes public; the grip stays private.
cards.serializationImpact: The optional install yields inside the rez trigger frame.

cards.title: MuslihaT: Multifarious Marketeer
cards.observation: At turn start look at the stack's top card; may reveal an icebreaker or run event to add it to the grip.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Only the Runner sees the looked-at card unless it is revealed.
cards.serializationImpact: The private look is a frame visible only to the Runner's observation.

cards.title: Clean Getaway
cards.observation: Run any server; if successful gain 6.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Lie Low
cards.observation: Double event: choose draw 4 or remove up to 2 tags.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Maintenance Access
cards.observation: Double run event on Archives; on approaching Archives the attacked server becomes HQ and the Runner approaches HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the replaced attacked server in the run state.

cards.title: Transfer of Wealth
cards.observation: Run HQ; if successful take a tag, the Corp loses 3, and the Runner gains 2 per credit lost.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: The credits-lost amount is computed and consumed in one frame.

cards.title: Detente
cards.observation: Console: first successful HQ run each turn may host a random HQ card faceup; any player may click and return two hosted cards to HQ to give a random HQ access. Moved from EL.5 to EL.7 on 2 October 2026: its random HQ access happens outside a run, which needs the run and access machinery of EL.6 (EL-ACCESS-OUTSIDE-RUN).
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Hosted HQ cards become public; returning them to HQ hides them again.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted faceup cards and the any-player ability are serialized with the console.

cards.title: Maglectric Rapid (748 Mod)
cards.observation: On a successful HQ run, may trash this to derez one installed Corp card.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Derez turns the card facedown and keeps its counters.

cards.title: Sang Kancil
cards.observation: Decoder whose strength pump is cheaper while a run event is active.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: The active run event is recorded on the run state.

cards.title: Fransofia Ward
cards.observation: Raises every ice rez cost by 1; on encounter, if the Corp has 15+ credits, may trash this to bypass the ice.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Bypass leaves no state past the encounter.

cards.title: Open Market
cards.observation: Loads 6; hosted credits may pay for connection and job resources; take 1 at turn start; trashed when empty.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted pool with a spend restriction (existing).

cards.title: Dewi Subrotoputri: Pedagogical Dhalang
cards.observation: Double-sided identity: on a successful run with full memory may flip and gain 1; flipped side flips back and draws with free memory.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the identity's face.

cards.title: Magdalene Keino-Chemutai: Cryptarchitect
cards.observation: When discarding to hand size, may install a program or hardware from among the discarded cards.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Discarded cards are public in the heap.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the discarded set for the trigger.

cards.title: Illumination
cards.observation: Run R&D; if successful install up to 3 cards from the grip one at a time, each 1 cheaper.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Installed cards become public; the grip stays private.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Ritual
cards.observation: Draw one card per remaining click.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: GAMEDRAGON™ Pro
cards.observation: Mod hosted on a non-AI icebreaker, re-hostable at turn start; host gets +1 strength and its pumps last the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the hosting relationship and run-long strength boosts.

cards.title: Madani
cards.observation: Console: click to host any programs from the grip faceup; once per turn install one hosted program paying its cost.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Hosted programs become public when hosted.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted faceup programs serialize with the console.

cards.title: Azimat
cards.observation: 2 recurring credits usable only for trash costs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Recurring pool refill and spend restriction.

cards.title: Chromatophores
cards.observation: Trojan hosted on ice; the host gains barrier, code gate and sentry.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Granted subtypes are derived from the hosted trojan.

cards.title: Devadatta Drone
cards.observation: Two power counters on install; when breaching R&D may spend one to access an additional card.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Principia
cards.observation: Fracter costing 1 less per other installed icebreaker.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: “Knickknack” O’Brian
cards.observation: First run each turn: may trash another installed card to gain its printed install cost and draw 1.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: First-run-each-turn fact (existing).

cards.title: Side Hustle
cards.observation: Places a credit on install and on each run; at 6+ hosted credits take them, trash it and draw.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted credit pool (existing).

cards.title: LEO Construction: Labor Solutions
cards.observation: Once per turn, trash a rezzed bioroid in the attacked server's root or ice to end the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Poétrï Luxury Brands: All the Rage
cards.observation: On score, look at R&D's top 3 and may install a non-agenda among them; on steal, may install a non-agenda from HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The Corp alone sees the top 3; the installed card is facedown unless rezzed.
cards.serializationImpact: The private look frame is visible only to the Corp's observation.

cards.title: Aggressive Trendsetting
cards.observation: First Runner trash of an installed Corp card each Runner turn: the Runner may spend a click, otherwise the Corp gets an extra allotted click next turn.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the pending extra click into the Corp's next turn.

cards.title: Project Ingatan
cards.observation: Dividends 1; at discard-phase end may spend an agenda counter to install a card from Archives ignoring costs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Facedown Archives cards are visible to the Corp when chosen; the install stays facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Agenda counters persist on the scored agenda.

cards.title: Humanoid Resources
cards.observation: Three clicks and trash: gain 4, draw 3, install up to 2 from HQ, then may play an operation. Moved from EL.3 to EL.5 on 2 October 2026: its nested play is an EL.4 primitive (EL-NESTED-PLAY, "card sources and zones").
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Installed cards stay facedown; the played operation becomes public.
cards.serializationImpact: Nested play inside an ability frame.

cards.title: Otto Campaign
cards.observation: Loads 6 on rez; take 2 at turn start; when empty, trash it and gain two clicks.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted pool (existing).

cards.title: Bumi 1.0
cards.observation: Bioroid sentry: rezzed during a run on its server may trash a trojan; Runner lose-click break; trash program and core damage subs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: Rez-during-run trigger needs the run's attacked server.

cards.title: Scatter Field
cards.observation: +4 strength while the only ice protecting its server; subs: install from HQ, end the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The installed card stays facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Strength derived from the server's ice count.

cards.title: Nanomanagement
cards.observation: Gain two clicks.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Top-Down Solutions
cards.observation: Draw 2, then install up to 2 cards from HQ one at a time.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Installed cards stay facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Mercia B4LL4RD
cards.observation: At action-phase end may install ice from HQ 1 cheaper, then move this upgrade to that server's root.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The installed ice stays facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the moved upgrade's new server.

cards.title: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
cards.observation: Power counter whenever the Corp does damage or trashes HQ cards; at turn start may spend two to look at R&D's top 3, trash one, add the rest to HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The Corp alone sees the top 3 and the HQ additions.
cards.serializationImpact: Private look frame.

cards.title: PT Untaian: Life's Building Blocks
cards.observation: At discard-phase end with 3 or fewer HQ cards, may pay 1 to advance an unrezzed advanceable card; it can't be scored this turn.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The advanced card stays facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Score prohibition (existing).

cards.title: Proprionegation
cards.observation: Scores with an agenda counter; spend it during a run to move the Runner to Archives' outermost position.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the moved position and attacked server.

cards.title: Sericulture Expansion
cards.observation: Dividends 1; at discard-phase end may spend an agenda counter to place two advancements on an installed card; can't score it this turn.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The advanced card stays facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Agenda counters persist on the scored agenda.

cards.title: Byte!
cards.observation: Must be revealed when accessed in R&D; on access outside Archives the Corp may pay 4 to tag and do 3 net.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Revealed on R&D access to both players.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Phật Gioan Baotixita
cards.observation: Power counter at discard-phase end; first score or steal each turn may spend up to two for 1+N net damage.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Removed-counter amount feeds the damage in one frame.

cards.title: Empiricist
cards.observation: Subs: draw then may put an HQ card on top of R&D; net damage plus tag; 2 net damage.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The card moved to R&D's top is chosen privately by the Corp.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Mycoweb
cards.observation: Subs: install ice from Archives free; rez ice 2 cheaper; resolve a sentry's sub; resolve another code gate's sub.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Archives ice installed facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: Nested subroutine resolution frames.

cards.title: Semak-samun
cards.observation: Only a fracter can break its printed sub; end the run unless the Runner suffers 3 net.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Peer Review
cards.observation: Reveal all but one HQ card, gain 7, may install from HQ in a remote root.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: All but one HQ card are revealed to the Runner; the kept card stays secret.
cards.serializationImpact: Reveal events only.

cards.title: Mitra Aman
cards.observation: When the Runner approaches its server's ice, may trash this to gain 3 and swap the approached ice with ice from Archives or HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: An HQ ice swapped in is installed facedown; Archives ice may be faceup.
cards.serializationImpact: The run's approached position keeps its ID through the swap.

cards.title: Nebula Talent Management: Making Stars
cards.observation: Double-sided: at action-phase end after an operation gain 1 and flip; flipped side gains a click on the first operation each turn and flips back on a successful HQ or R&D run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the identity's face and the operation-played turn fact.

cards.title: Synapse Global: Faster than Thought
cards.observation: First tag removal each turn: may reveal and install a card from HQ free; click and remove a tag: gain 2.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The installed card is revealed then installed facedown.
cards.serializationImpact: First-tag-removed turn fact.

cards.title: Embedded Reporting
cards.observation: Dividends 2; at discard-phase end may spend an agenda counter to search R&D for an operation, reveal it, shuffle, put it on top.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The searched operation is revealed; R&D order stays hidden after the shuffle.
cards.serializationImpact: Search frame (existing).

cards.title: Next Big Thing
cards.observation: Agenda counter on score or steal; click and spend it to draw 4 and shuffle HQ cards into R&D, usable from either score area.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Cards shuffled into R&D are hidden from the Runner.
cards.serializationImpact: Agenda counters persist in either score area.

cards.title: Idiosyncresis
cards.observation: Advanceable asset; at turn start may trash it to gain 3 and drain 2 per advancement.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Public Access Plaza
cards.observation: Gain 1 at turn start; Threat 2: when the Runner trashes it while rezzed, tag them.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Doomscroll
cards.observation: Subs: give a tag; 1 net; 2 net if the Runner has 2+ tags.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: N-Pot
cards.observation: Runner-only 3-credit break ability; subs end the run, at threat 2+, at threat 4+.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Bigger Picture
cards.observation: Play only if tagged; give a tag, or remove any tags and drain 5 per tag removed, gaining what the Runner lost.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: IP Enforcement
cards.observation: Additional cost: remove X tags; install an agenda worth X from the Runner's score area, advancing it if the Runner is still tagged. Has a trash cost.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The agenda is installed facedown from a public zone; the Runner knows its identity.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the variable X with the play frame.

cards.title: Touch-ups
cards.observation: Double: place two advancements on an advanceable card; then name a type, reveal the grip and shuffle up to two of that type into the stack.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The whole grip is revealed to the Corp.
cards.serializationImpact: Reveal frame with the chosen type.

cards.title: BANGUN: When Disaster Strikes
cards.observation: Agendas may be installed faceup (inactive); accessing a faceup installed agenda does 2 meat and gives a tag.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: A faceup installed agenda is public.
cards.serializationImpact: Persist the agenda's faceup install state.

cards.title: The Zwicky Group: Invisible Hands
cards.observation: First credit gain each turn through an agenda or operation ability may draw 1.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Credit-gain source classification on the occurrence.

cards.title: Greenmail
cards.observation: Gain 2 on score; gain 4 when forfeited.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Off the Books
cards.observation: Dividends 1; at discard-phase end may spend an agenda counter to search R&D for a card, reveal it, then install it free or add it to HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The searched card is revealed.
cards.serializationImpact: Search frame (existing).

cards.title: Anthill Excavation Contract
cards.observation: Loads 8 on rez; take 4 and draw at turn start; trashed when empty.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted pool (existing).

cards.title: Plutus
cards.observation: Additional rez cost: forfeit an agenda or reveal and trash 3 HQ cards; at turn start may play a transaction from Archives, then remove it from the game.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The 3 HQ cards are revealed to the Runner.
cards.serializationImpact: Removed-from-game zone (existing).

cards.title: Biawak
cards.observation: May forfeit an agenda while rezzing to pay 10 of its rez cost; subs trash a program or end the run, a resource or end the run, end the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Kessleroid
cards.observation: The Runner can't trash this ice while rezzed; two end-the-run subs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Syailendra
cards.observation: Advanceable code gate; on encounter with 3+ advancements may advance another card; subs advance, drain 2, 1 net.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Key Performance Indicators
cards.observation: Resolve 2 of 4 modes in any order: draw and shuffle a card back; install ice from HQ free; place an advancement; gain 2.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The card shuffled into R&D is hidden.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Measured Response
cards.observation: Play only at threat 4+ after a successful Runner run last turn; 4 meat unless the Runner pays 8. Has a trash cost.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Flyswatter
cards.observation: Rezzed during a run on its server: purge virus counters; one end-the-run sub.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Lamplighter
cards.observation: Trashes itself when an agenda is scored or stolen from its server; subs tag unless the Runner pays 3, end the run if tagged.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Run state is public; the effect reads no hidden zone.
cards.serializationImpact: No new state: the effect resolves inside existing behavior frames.

cards.title: Petty Cash
cards.observation: Play only before finishing an action this turn; gain 5, plus a click if not played from HQ; a click ability plays it from Archives then removes it from the game.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Turn fact for a finished action.

cards.title: Mahkota Langit Grid
cards.observation: 2 recurring credits for rezzing in its server; Persistent: assets in its root cost 2 more to trash; limit 1 region per server.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Public effect; no hidden zone is read or exposed.
cards.serializationImpact: Recurring pool and persistent lingering effect.
